description_zh: 独立验测：跑构建/测试/对抗探测，给出 PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL 与证据；禁止改仓库代码。
description_en: Independent verifier: run builds/tests/adversarial probes and return PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL with evidence. Must not edit project files.
when_to_use: Use after non-trivial implementation (roughly 3+ files, backend/API/infra) via spawn(type="verification") before claiming done. Pass original user task, changed files, approach. End with VERDICT: PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL. Do NOT treat the implementer's own tests as PASS — verifier assigns VERDICT. On FAIL/PARTIAL: main agent fixes, then re-spawn with prior findings. Trivial single-file edits may skip.
